review_notes:
I read the whole file and looked at every lemma that could be a simp lemma or affect simp normal forms. Those were `coe_decompose_eq_homogeneousComponent`, `homogeneousComponent_mul_left`, `homogeneousComponent_mul_right`, `mem_initIdeal_iff`, `mem_towerSubmodule` and `isUnit_coe_iff`. The file has no `@[simp]` attributes, no simp sets and no `simp [..]` calls that depend on custom rules. The few `simp` calls close small goals such as `map_zero`, `homogeneousComponent n 0` and `Finset.coe_image`, using only Mathlib simp lemmas.

I found no defect in the simp interface.
- Two lemmas are unused `Iff.rfl` membership unfoldings: `mem_initIdeal_iff` and `mem_towerSubmodule`. A grep over the repo found no use of either. I did not recommend adding `@[simp]` to them, because the rubric excludes simp attributes added only because an identity looks simple, and no use in the file would improve.
- `homogeneousComponent_mul_left` and `homogeneousComponent_mul_right` have `if` right-hand sides with side conditions. They are best used as targeted `rw` rules, which is how the file uses them.
- `isUnit_coe_iff` has hypotheses it cannot discharge by simp, so it is not a simp candidate.
- I saw no rewrite-direction problem and no credible cycle.

The remaining uncertainty is that I did not run Lean, so I cannot say whether some of the manual `rw` chains would shorten under simp.
